messages.subject: Problem in model evaluation
parts:
Dear INLA help,

I appreciate all the help I have received from you.

I am having some trouble with the evaluation of a logistic gam model using INLA. Both the effective number of parameters and DIC are equal to "Inf". Does anyone have any idea why am I getting this result and what I can do about it?

Also the PIT values are highly skewed to the left with about 50% of the data having PIT values equal to 1. I know that a perfect model is supposed to have a nearly uniform distribution but haven't been able to find any information about what to do when that is not the case. Could someone let me know whether that means the model is invalid and what to do in those cases?

Here is the formula I am using:
y~f(inla.group(x, n=100), model="rw2") + +f(id, model="bym", graph=g) + f(year.struct, model= "rw2") +  f(year, model= "iid")

Please let me know if you need details about the model specification.

Thanks for any help.

Victor.
